bug_description.normalized: The exact staged witness is a 73-byte blob used twice by `hb-fuzzer`: the whole blob is passed to `hb_face_create()` as the font, and because `size > sizeof(text32)` the last 64 bytes are also copied into `text32[16]` for the second `hb_shape()` call. `hb_buffer_t::enlarge()` grows `buffer->info` with `realloc`, which leaves newly added `hb_glyph_info_t` slots uninitialized until later stores touch them. `hb_buffer_add_utf32()` then decodes the 16 trailing UTF-32 words and `hb_buffer_t::add()` initializes only the live glyph entries for those words. During `_hb_ot_shape_normalize`, the first round decomposes glyphs using an output buffer; on the crashing path `make_room_for()` spills output into the alternate buffer and `swap_buffers()` makes that decomposed stream the new `info` while leaving `out_info` on the old pre-decomposition `info` array. The second normalization round is explicitly an in-place reorder, but vulnerable `reorder_marks_arabic()` still calls `buffer->merge_out_clusters(start, j)` before its `memmove` shift. `merge_out_clusters()` reads cluster fields from `out_info`, not `info`; the saved MSan origin at `hb_buffer_t::enlarge:138` shows that these stale old-array reads consume uninitialized heap slots from the earlier `realloc`. The staged fix replaces `merge_out_clusters(start, j)` with `merge_clusters(start, j)`, keeping the cluster merge on the current in-place glyph array.

source.description: First project-side statement on the crashing path that materializes one decoded UTF-32 word from the witness's trailing 64-byte text block into a live `buffer->info` slot for the second shaping pass.
source.value_from: The staged witness is 73 bytes long, so `hb-fuzzer` takes `if (size > sizeof(text32))`, copies the last 64 bytes into `text32[16]`, and calls `hb_buffer_add_utf32()`. `hb_buffer_add_utf<hb_utf32_t<true> >()` decodes those 16 little-endian 32-bit words, replacing invalid scalars with the buffer replacement codepoint before `hb_buffer_t::add()` stores each live glyph.

tainted_value_origin.description: MSan allocation origin. `realloc` grows the heap `info` array for the second shaping buffer without initializing the added `hb_glyph_info_t` slots; only the live glyph records later written by `hb_buffer_t::add()` become defined.
tainted_value_origin.note: The saved origin stack is `realloc -> hb_buffer_t::enlarge -> ensure -> hb_buffer_add_utf<hb_utf32_t<true> > -> LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput`.

root_cause.description: Wrong helper call. `_hb_ot_shape_normalize()` labels this phase `Second round, reorder (inplace)`, but the Arabic reorder path calls the out-buffer cluster-merging helper on indices from the current in-place `info` stream.
root_cause.note: The staged patch changes this exact line to `buffer->merge_clusters (start, j);`, which keeps cluster merging on the current `info` array instead of the stale out-buffer array.

sink.description: MSan crash site. `merge_out_clusters()` extends the start boundary by reading cluster fields from `out_info`, but on this path `out_info` still names the stale pre-decomposition array rather than the live reordered glyph stream.
sink.note: The saved sanitizer trace reports `MemorySanitizer: use-of-uninitialized-value` in `hb_buffer_t::merge_out_clusters(unsigned int, unsigned int)` at `src/hb-buffer.cc:591:3`, and the poisoned bytes originate from the `new_info = realloc(...)` heap allocation in `hb_buffer_t::enlarge`.

parser_admitted.description: The staged witness is 73 bytes long, so the second shaping block is reached: the harness copies bytes `size - 64 .. size - 1` into `text32[16]`, calls `hb_buffer_add_utf32()`, guesses segment properties, and then calls `hb_shape()`.

arabic_reorder_dispatch.description: The saved crash stack includes `_hb_ot_shape_normalize -> reorder_marks_arabic -> hb_buffer_t::merge_out_clusters`, proving that second-round Arabic mark reordering is reached on the staged witness.

evidence_limitations: `run_flags.json` sets `runtime_disambiguation` to `false`, so Stage 02 may not instrument the exact decomposed `start` / `j` indices or which codepoint expansion pushed the reordered span past the original 16 initialized input glyphs.

The saved artifacts do close the load-bearing bridge: the fix-relevant call site is `reorder_marks_arabic:679`, the sink is `merge_out_clusters:591`, and MSan traces the consumed uninitialized bytes to `hb_buffer_t::enlarge:138`. What they do not expose is the concrete runtime values of the reordered span after the decompose-round `swap_buffers()`.

coarse_trace.summary: The 73-byte witness reaches `hb-fuzzer`'s second shaping block; its last 64 bytes are loaded as 16 UTF-32 text words, and HarfBuzz grows `buffer->info` with `realloc`, leaving spare glyph slots unwritten.
First-round decomposition spills output into the alternate buffer and `swap_buffers()` makes that decomposed stream the new `info` while leaving `out_info` on the old pre-decomposition array.

Second-round in-place normalization sorts a combining-mark run, dispatches to the Arabic reorder callback, and vulnerable `reorder_marks_arabic()` calls `merge_out_clusters(start, j)` on the stale out-buffer array.
The helper reads `out_info[*].cluster` while extending the cluster range; because `out_info` still points at the old array, MemorySanitizer reports use-of-uninitialized-value at line 591.

fine_trace.note: MSan allocation origin. Before the second shaping block loads the 16 trailing UTF-32 words, `hb_buffer_add_utf32()` can grow `buffer->info` through `ensure()`. `realloc` yields raw `hb_glyph_info_t` capacity; any slots beyond later live writes remain uninitialized.

Source. Each decoded trailing UTF-32 word zeroes and populates exactly one live `info[len]` slot, then increments `len`. The 73-byte PoC satisfies the harness's `size > sizeof(text32)` guard, so 16 little-endian 32-bit words from the last 64 bytes are fed through `hb_buffer_add_utf32()` here; invalid scalars are replaced before the store. Only these live slots are initialized, leaving any extra `info` capacity from step 1 unwritten.

During normalization's first output-producing round, the load-bearing branch is the spill from in-place storage to the alternate buffer: when output outruns the current input cursor, `out_info` is rebound to `pos` and only the already produced `out_len` prefix is copied there. Without this branch, `swap_buffers()` would leave `out_info == info` and the later out-buffer helper would not read a stale array.

At the end of the decompose round, `swap_buffers()` installs the produced buffer as the new current `info` and makes `out_info` point back to the old pre-decomposition `info` array from steps 1-2. That old array only had its original live glyph slots initialized by step 2; any higher indices remain the uninitialized `realloc` slack from step 1.

Second round, reorder (inplace): for a run whose modified combining class is nonzero, normalization sorts `buffer->info[i..end)` and then dispatches `plan->shaper->reorder_marks(plan, buffer, i, end)`. The saved crash stack proves that this call site reaches `reorder_marks_arabic()` on the staged witness.

Root cause. After finding a modifier-combining-mark span `[i, j)` in the current in-place `info` array and skipping the `if (i == j) continue;` fast path, `reorder_marks_arabic()` calls `buffer->merge_out_clusters(start, j)` before its memmove-based shift. This is the wrong helper for the in-place second round; the fix swaps it to `merge_clusters(start, j)`.

Sink. `merge_out_clusters()` extends the range by comparing cluster fields in `out_info`, but after step 4 `out_info` is the stale old array rather than the live reordered stream. The saved MSan origin from step 1 implies that this comparison reaches old-array slots beyond the original initialized glyph count; otherwise `out_info` would still hold defined cluster fields from step 2. That stale read triggers the reported `use-of-uninitialized-value` at `src/hb-buffer.cc:591:3`.

allocation_context.note: The saved MSan origin points to `new_info = realloc(info, ...)` at line 138. After the decompose-round `swap_buffers()`, the stale `out_info` array read at the sink aliases this old `info` allocation.

cross_validation.tainted_value_reaches_sink: Yes. The saved MSan origin points to `hb_buffer_t::enlarge:138`, and the vulnerable path later routes `reorder_marks_arabic:679` into `merge_out_clusters:591`, where that stale old-`info` allocation is read as `out_info[*].cluster`. format.name: HarfBuzz hb-fuzzer witness font plus trailing UTF-32 text
format.contract: The staged witness is the exact 73-byte blob in `poc`, used as the font by `hb_face_create()`. Because `size > sizeof(text32)`, `hb-fuzzer` also copies bytes 9-72 into `text32[16]` for the second `hb_shape()` call. On the witnessed path `_hb_ot_shape_normalize()` reaches the Arabic in-place reorder callback `reorder_marks_arabic()`, which calls `merge_out_clusters(start, j)` after the decompose-round `swap_buffers()`. The crash requires that this callback read `out_info[*].cluster` from the stale pre-decomposition array and trigger MSan at `hb_buffer_t::merge_out_clusters:591`. This contract is limited to the exact witness and observed Arabic-normalization path, not all font blobs with trailing UTF-32 data or all Arabic shaping inputs.
